CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n3), its presentation as coordinates, and an origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change claim tied to the identified content's organization or access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (color 'red') bound to a referent with coordinates.

D.rationale: The report separately records an origin/status field for the same content referent, distinguishing source/status from content identity.

O.rationale: The coordinates listing specifies how the content is presented/organized for the given referent/time.
